name: Tuberose o Anata ni.
original_name: チューベローズを貴方に。
source:
"At least for me, I kind of regretted it, so I might actually be happy to get some help."  
The protagonist, taking advantage of her mother's remarriage, became a young lady from a good family.  
It's been a year since she started living with her suddenly-appeared brother, who is eight years older, and though they still have an awkward relationship, they're getting by together.  
Then, she learns from her other brother that his birthday is coming up.  
Will she be able to safely give a birthday present to her grumpy older brother…?

[Translated from [url=http://worldalicesyndrome.web.fc2.com/tub/top.html]official game webpage page[/url]]
